| la fiebre | fever | Tengo fiebre y escalofríos. |
| la tos | cough | Tengo tos y me duele la garganta. |

TL;DR: when kids use screens matters more than how much. In a 2025 study of 1,200 kids aged 6 to 9, screens in the hour before bed delayed sleep by about 19 minutes, because screen light delays melatonin, games and short videos keep kids wired, and screens crowd out wind-down routines like baths and reading. What worked: a fixed screens-off time an hour before bed every night including weekends, devices charged in the kitchen, the TV in a shared room, and reading for the last half hour, which normalized sleep within two weeks. Weekday screen time under two hours is fine once timing is fixed, and if a child protests, offer a choice of two books rather than a negotiation about minutes. Action: None, unless you want a reply for the group chat.

TFSA: you contribute after-tax money, growth and withdrawals are tax-free, and withdrawn room comes back next year, so it's flexible. RRSP: contributions are tax-deductible now, growth is tax-deferred, and withdrawals are taxed later, so it's best when your tax rate now is higher than it will be in retirement. Action: None.
